color.note: One committed world: points of light on deep ink. Orange means needs/action, ice blue means enables; never swap them.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Ink Night · page and field background.

tokens.usage: Raised Ink · component specimens and the command palette surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text (≥ 12:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Leads, secondary text, labels (7:1 on bg).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decoration only (3.6:1, never body copy).

tokens.name: hot

tokens.name: hot-2

tokens.name: panel
